proof_review: boundary_cover_bool is the exact 11-Bool implication with 16 negative edge constraints and 24 independent-set complements; ordinary decide supplies a kernel-checked proof.

target_negative_cover_check instantiates the 11 Boolean variables with membership in S, and simplification converts the complement clauses to subset tests. List.any_eq_true and of_decide_eq_true supply an actual covering listed set.
target_negative_independent separately checks all listed negative sets; the sufficiency direction only needs their coverage and the candidate negative evaluations.
circuit_eval_mono reads only the AND/OR operation component of Monotone2, then invokes existing pos_mono at C.output+1, definitionally the actual Circuit.eval read.
In the forward direction, failure of edgeTrue makes the true-coordinate support independent. A covering listed set dominates the input, contradicting its stipulated false evaluation.
In the backward direction, a true target edge pair is below x; monotonicity raises its stipulated true evaluation. Both orientations of targetGraph.Adj are handled explicitly.
There is no clean-AND, gate-count, index-validity, exact-two-input, or nonempty-input premise. Existing evaluator monotonicity handles default-false reads and constants.

The symmetric targetGraph edge predicate matches the posted oriented natural-number edge list existential, since swapping existential vertices preserves the two true-coordinate conjuncts; final assembly must still use the exact posted statement.
